messages.author: 6e273306fdbed10a
messages.subject: How can I merge 2 accounts?
parts:
Hi!

I've registered 2 account by mistake.

Account A has a proper name.
Account B is paid and has all the apps.

I want to use the name of account A with account B (account A can be deleted).

How can I solve this?

Cheers!

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How can I merge 2 accounts?
parts:
I would rename Account A to something else, then you can rename account B to Account A's name.  
Hope this helps.
-Tareef
